english.title: Refuse to give address to cab driver after refusal / failure to pay fare
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having failed or refused to pay a fare lawfully due from you in respect of a cab, refused to give to the driver an address at which you could be found
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(c) of the London Cab Act 1896.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
with respect to a cab
having failed or refused to pay a fare lawfully due from you
refused to give to the driver an address at which you could be found

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) cab shall mean any hackney carriage within the meaning of the Metropolitan Public Carriage Act 1869 - section 3 LCA 1896
english.standardstatementoffacts:

other.penalty:
Summary: 14 days imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level one on the standard scale

Time limit for prosecutions:
Six months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level one on the legislative standard scale
